description: ISS pass predictions — $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Payment follows the x402 two-phase exchange: unpaid calls with lat/lon receive the live payment requirements (payTo, amount, networks), and calls carrying a valid payment receive the passes in the tool result. Computed from public CelesTrak orbital data. The tool itself makes no payments and handles no private keys. Example: {lat:30.5651, lon:-97.8441} (an unpaid call returns payment_required; a paid call returns the passes).

payment.description: Base64-encoded x402 v1 payment payload (the signed ExactEvmPayload JSON). Absent on the first call, which receives the payment requirements; present on the follow-up call, after signing in the caller's own wallet / x402 client. The server only forwards it to the rail — it never signs, never holds funds, never touches private keys.

name: qm_data_iss_pass
